# Overview of MicroDuck Task Demonstration

Here, it is demonstrated by splitting into tasks to avoid combining different policies, algorithms, or physical interactions into a single result. The GPU and BPU videos in each notebook correspond to the same task; expanding the items reveals the complete task list and additional versions.

> **Video口径:** GPU GIF is a saved Notebook inference replay; BPU GIF is a closed loop video cache left by the previous Notebook execution, which does not indicate that the reader is calling RDK in real time when opening GitHub. Re-running BPU units requires the corresponding HBM task, RDK service, and simulation workstation. Browser physical perturbation refers to manual drag/external interaction, not a trained anti-interference recovery strategy. The climbing surface currently only shows阶段性 results; it is not a continuous climb or summiting.

## Materials and Reproduction

- All submitted video previews are in GIF format; the MP4 files in Notebook outputs have been replaced by relative GIF links.
- The original MP4 files do not enter the main repository, reducing cloning and browsing overhead. Details on the environment, model, metrics, and full replay instructions for each task can be found in the corresponding task README.
- The board-side task videos for RDK X5 are independent reasoning per task; Ubuntu is responsible for physical simulation and encoding, while BPU handles action reasoning. The videos marked “cache” on this page come from previously saved execution outputs.
